# Microchip overlays

Per-family TOML overlays consumed by `microchip_overlay_v2_1.py`.
Most are auto-generated by `scripts/scaffold_family_overlay.py`
from a representative ATDF; a few (`avr-da/`, `same70/`,
`samd21/`, `samd51/`, `saml21/`, `samv71/`) ship hand-curated
clock profiles + per-peripheral max-clock annotations on top of
the auto-extracted memory map.

## Full coverage (post-PIC integration)

| Architecture | Families | Chips | Sources | Schema |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ARM Cortex-M (SAM, PIC32C, AVR-DA) | 51 | 326 | atdf + overlay [+ csp] | ATDF |
| MIPS (PIC32MX) | 1 | 120 | atdf + overlay | ATDF |
| AVR 8-bit (ATmega/ATtiny/ATautomotive) | 3 | 229 | atdf + overlay | ATDF |
| PIC8 (PIC16/PIC18/MCP/MCV) | 6 | 605 | pic + overlay | EDC `.PIC` |
| PIC24 | 7 | 247 | pic + overlay | EDC `.PIC` |
| dsPIC | 14 | (counts in `vendors/`) | pic + overlay | EDC `.PIC` |
| Other Microchip MCUs (CEC/EEC/HCS/MEC/DEC/LAN9) | 4+ | (counts in `vendors/`) | atdf or pic + overlay | mixed |
| **Grand total** | **63** | **2396 chips** | | |

CSP enrichment (`microchip-csp` source = auto-derived
`clock.domains[].select_register` from Harmony's `clk.py` +
ATDF value-groups) is active for **15 ARM families**:
samc20, samc21, samd09–samd21, samd51, same51/53/54, same70,
saml21, saml22, sams70, samv70, samv71.

## Refreshing

```bash
# 1. Pull latest atpacks
python3 scripts/fetch_microchip_dfps.py \
    --cache <cache>/microchip-dfp

# 2. Pull latest Harmony CSP (clock-tree XMLs)
git -C <cache>/microchip-csp pull --depth 1

# 3. Re-emit every family
python3 scripts/bulk_re_emit_all_microchip.py \
    --dfp-cache <cache>/microchip-dfp \
    --csp-root  <cache>/microchip-csp \
    --out       /path/to/alloy-devices-yml
```

## Known gaps

### SAM3X / SAM4S / SAM4E / SAM4N / SAM4L (legacy)

These pre-acquisition Atmel parts are **not** published on
[packs.download.microchip.com](https://packs.download.microchip.com/)
and have no entry in
[Microchip-MPLAB-Harmony/dev_packs](https://github.com/Microchip-MPLAB-Harmony/dev_packs).
The only place to source their ATDFs is the legacy Atmel Studio
7 installer (Windows, ~700 MB), where the packs ship inside
`<install>/packs/atmel/`.

Workaround: download the matching pack manually, drop the
extracted directory into `<cache>/microchip-dfp/sam3x-<sha>/`
(matching the `<family>-<16-hex>/` pattern that
`bulk_re_emit_all_microchip.py` discovers), and add a
`vendors/microchip/sam3x/family.toml` overlay.  The extractors
already handle the Cortex-M3 detection path.

### CSP without overlay-curated clock.profiles

Auto-scaffolded overlays carry only generic `factory-default`
+ `<core>-max` clock profiles; the named PLL sources (DFLL,
FDPLL, PLLA) come from the CSP enrichment.  Hand-tuning the
profile names to vendor-canonical values (`pll-hsi-150mhz`-
style) would improve developer ergonomics — tracked as a
follow-up.
